disclosure: Fictional game. All characters, parties and events are invented; any resemblance to real people is coincidental. Not affiliated with or endorsed by any political party, aspirant or electoral body. Scores are game scores, not polls.
closing: Campaign period over. Go vote on 16 Jan. Check your PVC and polling unit.
backSoon: Back soon. We're making the road smoother.
rosterFair: Every Contender is balanced: each perk is paired with a trade-off, so no choice scores higher than another. Pick the one you like.
rosterLock: Your Contender locks when you finish your first full campaign run. Quick rallies never lock it. After that you get one switch, then it is fixed for the campaign.
studioLooks: What you put them in is yours alone: the outfit stays on this device and never changes how your Contender plays.
